headline: 4 crude bombs explode in Patuakhali’s Bauphal
summary: The explosions occurred in front of the upazila parishad on Monday night, causing panic among local residents.
details: Four crude bombs exploded in front of the upazila parishad in Bauphal municipality of Patuakhali on Monday night.
The incident took place around 9:15pm near the Bauphal Police Station, spreading panic among locals.
Witnesses reported hearing four separate explosions at intervals of approximately one minute each.
Sirajul Islam, officer-in-charge of Bauphal Police Station, confirmed that police arrived at the scene after receiving information about the blasts.
The police are currently investigating the matter to determine the cause and perpetrators of the explosions.
Following the incident, local members of Chhatra Dal brought out a procession around 9:45pm.

headline: CUET students lock VC's office building over VC change
summary: Students of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) protested against the removal of Professor Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem as Vice Chancellor.
details: Students of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) held a protest march on Monday night, demanding the reinstatement of former Vice Chancellor Professor Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem.

The protest erupted after Professor Sayem was removed from his post after only 56 days in office. He was replaced by Professor Sheikh Shariful Alam of Khulna University of Engineering and Technology (KUET).
The demonstration began at the university's Swadhinata Chattar, Swadhinata Square,at 10:30 PM and moved through various academic buildings, female students' halls, and teacher residential areas.
Many female students joined the march despite their residential halls being closed at 8:00 PM, exiting their halls around 11:00 PM to join the protest.
The march ended at midnight at Swadhinata Chattar, after which students locked the Vice Chancellor's office building, effectively shutting down the office.
Student leaders stated that only Professor Sayem can unlock the building, and criticized the removal of a 'student-friendly' and 'qualified' VC without any reason provided.
Professor Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem, a professor of the Mechanical Engineering department, was appointed as VC of CUET on July 27, and was removed on Monday.
caption:
Students lock the VC's office building at CUET! They are demanding the reinstatement of a VC who was removed after just 56 days.

Students of Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) held a protest march on Monday night, demanding the reinstatement of former Vice Chancellor Professor Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem.

The protest erupted after Professor Sayem was removed from his post after only 56 days in office. He was replaced by Professor Sheikh Shariful Alam of Khulna University of Engineering and Technology (KUET).

The demonstration began at the university's Swadhinata Chattar, Swadhinata Square,at 10:30 PM and moved through various academic buildings, female students' halls, and teacher residential areas.

Many female students joined the march despite their residential halls being closed at 8:00 PM, exiting their halls around 11:00 PM to join the protest.

The march ended at midnight at Swadhinata Chattar, after which students locked the Vice Chancellor's office building, effectively shutting down the office.

Student leaders stated that only Professor Sayem can unlock the building, and criticized the removal of a 'student-friendly' and 'qualified' VC without any reason provided.

Professor Abu Sadat Muhammad Sayem, a professor of the Mechanical Engineering department, was appointed as VC of CUET on July 27, and was removed on Monday.
